findings.description: Direct inspection of all eleven V157 renders: the skirt still reads as broad, flared panel faces with shallow, irregular ridges; three repeated pleat cycles per panel and a deliberate hem cadence are not legible at product scale.

The crouch and sit renders retain an angular, uneven upper-thigh shell edge visible through the front skirt opening; the shell does not follow the bent thighs closely enough to claim fit or adequate coverage.
Front, side, back and arm-cross renders continue to show pinched torso/waist facets and a discontinuous jacket-to-skirt junction, especially around the lower front panels.
The prone render remains a rigid horizontal spread of skirt panels over intersecting limbs without plausible cloth drape; the required pose evidence is visually unacceptable.

nextAction: Keep the V157 candidate REJECTED and prototype-only. V157 changed the panel-local crease topology and now produces a valid Blender/cloth/export/render/geometry run, but direct inspection still rejects pleat readability, thigh-shell contour, torso/waist continuity, and prone drape. Do not claim visual acceptance, fit, or release. Next change the dependency that creates broad skirt faces and distorted posed coverage, then inspect all eleven freshly rendered views again. UV, final materials, Shape Key behavior, Unity/VRChat execution, packaging, and release remain unverified.
